title: Associate Product Manager(Technical)
description:

 Asymmetric Labs is an AI\-first, new\-age ed\-tech company focused on delivering measurable outcomes such as improved ranks, job placements, and sustained career progression. Currently in stealth mode.
 


* Backed by Tier 1 US VCs
* Founding team of serial entrepreneurs
* Global team (Singapore / India / US)

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**About Us**
 Blitz enables Same\-Day Delivery for eCommerce brands to provide the best on\-time delivery experiences to their customers. Blitz aims to simplify scalability \& unlock the growth of new\-age eCommerce brands by making Same\-Day delivery more convenient, reliable \& affordable. Same\-Day Delivery helps brands with converting their browsers into buyers, serving as a competitive advantage and reducing working capital challenges. Blitz currently engages with enterprise brands with category focus into Fashion, Beauty \& Personal Care and Healthcare; helping them with 30% \- 40% increase in their website conversions \& increasing retention by 2x by providing best in class experience.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* 
+ Work closely with Product Managers to support product strategy, discovery, and execution.
+ Conduct user research and gather insights by speaking with riders, merchants, franchise owners, and internal operations teams.
+ Support and execute Product GTMs and launches.
+ Write clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
+ Create wireframes and prototypes using Figma to communicate product ideas.
+ Collaborate with Engineering, Design, Data, and Operations throughout the product lifecycle.
+ Analyze product performance using SQL, dashboards, and experimentation.
+ Define success metrics and track feature adoption and impact after launch.
+ Help prioritize features based on customer impact, business value, and data\-driven insights.
+ Coordinate product launches and ensure smooth rollout and adoption.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 
+ 1\+ years of experience in Product Management or a related role.
+ Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to use data to drive decisions.
+ Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
+ Customer\-first mindset with a passion for solving real user problems.
+ Ability to work in a fast\-paced, cross\-functional environment and manage multiple priorities.
+ Basic understanding of product development processes, experimentation, and agile methodologies.

title: Product Manager I
description:
**About The Team**
 Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e\-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers \- ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.
   

  

 Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us. 😉
   

  

 We are driven by a ‘user\-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ \& delivery \- not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.
   

  

 But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Product Manager I who is passionate about solving high\-impact problems in a fast\-paced start\-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross\-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category management, marketing, operations, finance, etc. to bring a new product to life.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
* Problem Identification \& Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
* Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology\-led ideas to solve the prioritised problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engineering., business, etc Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
* Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross\-functional team (design, engg. business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
* Go\-to\-Market Planning: Create a go\-to\-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
* Adoption \& Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
* Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3\-month forward\-looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.


**What You Will Need**
* Overall experience of 3\+ yrs with at least 1\+ yrs in product management in a tech\-led company (consumer internet space is preferred).
* Exceptional problem\-solving skills based on first principles of thinking.
* Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills to get work done across different functions and drive product development.

title: Founding Product Manager
description:
About the role
 
 We’re hiring a Product Manager who wants to build, not just manage. At Trupeer, product is at the core of everything we do. This is a zero\-to\-one, high\-ownership role where you’ll work directly with founders to own the product lifecycle end to end \- discover, build, test and distribute. If you’re someone who enjoys structured roadmaps, long planning cycles, and delegation, this role is not for you.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 * Own product problems end\-to\-end \- from identifying opportunities to shipping, scaling and taking solutions to end users.
* Operate with extreme speed: weekly shipping \> perfect planning
* Use AI tools aggressively to prototype, validate, and move faster than traditional teams
* Work hands\-on across design (Figma), analytics, and product workflows
* Scope new features and improvements by collecting insights across customers, usage data and market landscape
* Run experiments, iterate fast, and drive measurable impact on core product metrics
* Collaborate deeply with engineering and founders: no silos, no handoffs


 What we're looking for
 * 3–5 years of experience building products, preferably in early\-stage startups
* Strong bias for action and ownership: you don’t wait, you build
* Comfortable getting your hands dirty: design, analytics, execution
* Experience with tools: Figma, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Linear / Jira
* Experience with B2B products is a strong plus but not mandatory
* Ability to think from first principles and solve ambiguous problems
* High agency, high curiosity, and a strong sense of urgency

title: Fractional Product Manager – Lang Learning
description:
**About EnglishBhashi**
 EnglishBhashi is a product\-led EdTech company building AI\-powered language learning experiences for learners across India. Our mission is to make spoken English learning more personalized, practical, and accessible, particularly for learners from Tier 2, Tier 3, and Tier 4 cities.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced
 **Fractional Product Manager** 
 who can take meaningful ownership of our product and growth initiatives and work closely with the Founder and cross\-functional teams to drive measurable outcomes.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is a
 **high\-ownership, founder\-style product role** 
 .
   

  

 You will work approximately
 **3 hours per day with flexible working hours** 
 . The expectation is not about being available for a fixed number of hours, but about taking ownership of defined product outcomes and consistently moving them forward.
   

  

 You will be expected to think independently, identify opportunities, prioritize ruthlessly, work with data and users, and drive initiatives from:
   

  

**Problem → Insight → Hypothesis → Product → Launch → Measurement → Iteration**
 You will work directly with the Founder and collaborate with Engineering, Design, Content, Marketing, and Community teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Product Strategy \& Ownership
* Understand EnglishBhashi's product, users, business model, and growth objectives.
* Identify and prioritize the highest\-impact product opportunities.
* Own and continuously improve the product roadmap.
* Define product priorities based on user impact, business value, data, and execution effort.
* Convert ambiguous business problems into clear product opportunities and initiatives.
* Work closely with the Founder on product strategy and important product decisions.
* User Research \& Product Discovery
* Conduct user interviews, usability testing, and qualitative research.
* Develop a deep understanding of our learners, particularly Tier 2/3/4 audiences.
* Analyze user feedback, reviews, support conversations, and behavioral patterns.
* Identify key pain points affecting activation, engagement, learning outcomes, and retention.
* Study competitors and global language\-learning products.
* Convert insights into product hypotheses, requirements, and experiments.
* Product Analytics \& Funnel Optimization
* Own the product funnel across acquisition, onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, and conversion.
* Analyze product behavior using tools such as GA4, Firebase, Amplitude, Mixpanel, and Microsoft Clarity.
* Identify funnel drop\-offs, friction points, and behavioral patterns.
* Build and monitor cohorts and product metrics.
* Define and track product KPIs.
* Use data to identify opportunities and validate product decisions.
* Lifecycle, Engagement \& Retention
* Own product\-led engagement and retention initiatives.
* Design and optimize lifecycle journeys using CleverTap, MoEngage, WebEngage, or similar platforms.
* Build segmentation, push notification, in\-app messaging, and re\-engagement journeys.
* Improve onboarding and activation experiences.
* Develop habit loops around daily learning and practice.
* Experiment with streaks, missions, reminders, rewards, and personalized nudges.
* Continuously work toward improving user retention and engagement.
* Product Execution
* Write PRDs, user stories, feature specifications, and acceptance criteria.
* Work closely with Engineering and Design to translate ideas into shipped products.
* Support wireframes and prototypes where required.
* Drive execution of prioritized initiatives.
* Participate in QA and release validation.
* Analyze post\-launch performance and determine the next iteration.
* Ensure product initiatives do not stop at launch but are measured against outcomes.
* Growth \& Experimentation
* Identify product\-led growth opportunities.
* Develop hypotheses to improve activation, engagement, retention, and monetization.
* Design and execute product experiments and A/B tests.
* Measure experiment results and document learnings.
* Identify scalable growth loops within the product.
* Collaborate with Marketing, Content, and Community teams to improve the overall user journey.
* Strategic \& Founder Support
* Work directly with the Founder on high\-priority product and growth initiatives.
* Prepare product strategy documents, product briefs, dashboards, and presentations.
* Support investor, grant, accelerator, and strategic documentation when required.
* Bring structured thinking and data\-driven decision\-making to ambiguous problems.


**What We're Looking ForExperience**
* 3–6 years of experience in Product Management, Growth Product, Consumer Apps, UX, MarTech, or a related role.
* Experience owning products, features, funnels, or growth initiatives end\-to\-end.
* Experience working in a startup or fast\-paced product environment is strongly preferred.


 Must\-Have Skills
   

  

* Strong product thinking and ownership mindset.
* Strong understanding of product funnels, activation, engagement, retention, and cohorts.
* Hands\-on experience with GA4, Firebase, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar analytics tools.
* Hands\-on experience with CleverTap, MoEngage, WebEngage, or similar lifecycle engagement platforms.
* Strong understanding of lifecycle marketing, segmentation, automation, and retention.
* Experience writing PRDs, user stories, and product requirements.
* Ability to work effectively with Engineering and Design teams.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication skills.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.


 Good to Have
   

  

* Experience with consumer mobile apps.
* Experience in EdTech, language learning, or AI products.
* Experience working with Tier 2/3/4 Indian audiences.
* Experience with gamification and habit\-forming products.
* Familiarity with Figma, Jira, Notion, or similar tools.
* Understanding of LTV, CAC, conversion, monetization, and growth loops.


 What We Value
   

  

**We Are Looking For Someone Who**
* Takes ownership instead of waiting for instructions.
* Thinks in terms of outcomes, not tasks.
* Can identify what not to build.
* Is comfortable making decisions with incomplete information.
* Uses data but does not ignore qualitative user insights.
* Can move quickly from an idea to an experiment.
* Is comfortable challenging assumptions.
* Can independently drive initiatives from discovery to execution and measurement.
* Enjoys working closely with founders and small, ambitious teams.


 Engagement
   

  

**Fractional \| Approximately 3 hours per day \| Flexible working hours**
 This role is designed for an experienced product professional who wants to contribute meaningfully to a high\-growth startup while maintaining a flexible time commitment.
   

  

 The role offers significant autonomy and ownership, with the opportunity to directly influence
 **EnglishBhashi's product, growth, engagement, and retention strategy** 
 .
   

  

**If you are someone who can bring 3 hours of focused product ownership rather than simply 3 hours of availability, we'd love to hear from you.**

title: Group Product Manager - Pharmaceuticals
description:
**Position: Group Product Manager \- Pharmaceuticals** 




**Location: Bangalore (Corporate Office)** 




**Role: Full\-Time (No Hybrid and No WFH)** 




**Department: Marketing** 




**Portfolio: Gynae/Ortho/CP** 




**\-\-\-** 




**Description** 




 The role involves leading the end\-to\-end lifecycle of pharmaceutical brands, including market analysis, product positioning, and launch planning. The individual will collaborate closely with sales, medical affairs, digital transformation, and other teams to develop product strategies, promotional plans, and evidence\-based messaging aligned with company objectives.
 



  





**Key day\-to\-day responsibilities** 



* Monitoring product performance
* Analyzing market trends and competitor activity
* Developing brand communication
* Supporting field teams with necessary documents and tools
* Field Work \- Regular interaction with doctors, chemist, retailers, and other stakeholders
* Participation in conferences and events



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




 • B.Pharm is preferred. An MBA in Marketing / Pharmaceutical Management / Healthcare Management will be an added advantage.
 



 • Minimum 1–2 years of pharmaceutical sales experience as a Medical Representative / ABM or in a similar field role.
 



 • Minimum 8–10 years of Product Management Team (PMT) / pharmaceutical marketing experience.
 



 • Overall experience of approximately 11–12 years in the pharmaceutical industry preferred.
 



 • Candidates demonstrating career stability, preferably with at least 3 years in an organization, will be given preference.
 



 • Candidates who are not permanent residents of Mumbai, Gujarat, or Pune will be preferred.
 



 • English\-medium schooling preferred.
 



  





**Desired Qualifications** 




 • Candidates with experience in specialized therapy areas such as Orthopaedics, Gynaecology, and Physician\-focused segments will be preferred.
 



 • Strong experience in product management, brand management, market analysis, product positioning, and promotional strategy.
 



 • Ability to understand market trends, competitor activity, prescription behaviour, and customer insights to support brand strategy.
 



 • Experience in developing promotional materials, campaigns, training inputs, and field\-force communication.
 



 • Strong cross\-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
 



 • Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and analytical abilities.
 



  





**Company Description** 




 Pharmed Limited, headquartered in Bengaluru, India’s Silicon Valley, is one of the fastest\-growing pharmaceutical companies in the country. Since 1946, the organization has focused on “Caring for India,” delivering evidence\-based pharmaceutical and nutraceutical products that improve quality of life. Pharmed is widely recognized within the Indian medical community, with a portfolio that supports disease management and enhances lifestyle across specialized therapy areas. Its prescription\-driven brands are regularly promoted to gynaecologists, orthopedicians, physicians, dermatologists, and otolaryngologists.
 



  





 To know more, visit the 'About Us' page on LinkedIn or check the website for more.

title: Senior Product Manager - Cisco Wireless
description:

* Monitor product performance and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

* Experience in Wireless technologies and bonus points for deployment and design experience.
* Experience with network and change management for deployments
* Familiarity with software development lifecycle

description:
Scopely is looking for a
 **Lead Product Manager** 
 to join our Star Trek Fleet Command team in Bangalore, India on a hybrid basis.
   

  

 At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day—whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers developing, publishing, and innovating in the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.
   

  

**Star Trek™ Fleet Command** 
 is a top\-grossing MMO 4X strategy game that has captivated players for over five years. As we continue to expand and evolve the game, we are seeking a highly driven and analytical Lead Product Manager to own the performance and strategic direction of our live content, including monthly events, offers, and player experience.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 As Lead Product Manager, you’ll be the key driver for identifying, executing, and optimizing strategies that improve player engagement, retention, and monetization across our live game. You will focus on key LiveOps pillars such as events, feature performance, and live sales; ensuring that everything we launch is performant, data\-informed, and player\-first.
   

  

 You’ll work cross\-functionally with Product Marketing, Product Ops, and Analytics teams to define, prioritize, and deliver exceptional player experiences that meet both business and player goals.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**
* This position involves taking ownership of LiveOps excellence and driving the success of our LiveOps operations through effective leadership, critical thinking and flawless execution.
* Manage and develop a team of talented Product Managers. Contributing to a culture of product excellence and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Drive the performance strategy for LiveOps systems, recurring events, and monetization features, ensuring they meet player expectations and business KPIs.
* Perform analysis and optimization of live features and events, using data to identify opportunities, perform root\-cause diagnostics, and execute impactful improvements.
* Contribute to building a repeatable, scalable approach to LiveOps performance management and experimentation.
* Partner with UX, Research, and Community teams to develop empathy for player sentiment and pain points, and translate them into actionable product improvements.
* Develop clear documentation and KPIs for live operations, continuously iterating on performance with a test\-and\-learn mindset


**What We’re Looking For**
* 5\+ years of experience in product management, ideally with significant live operations responsibility in a F2P mobile game.
* Strong leadership skills.
* Demonstrated success managing complex monetization and engagement systems, with strong experience in event design, sales strategy, or player lifecycle management.
* Data\-native mindset, with the ability to translate raw performance metrics into strategic insights and actionable plans.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a proven track record of aligning diverse teams around a shared product vision.
* Strong player empathy and experience working with user research, community feedback, or other voice\-of\-player channels.
* Experience driving impact across cross\-functional pods, including creative, design, and engineering teams.


**Work Schedule**
 This role follows a non\-standard working schedule to support close collaboration with a U.S.\-based team. The position requires a regular daily overlap from 9:30 PM to 11:30 PM IST to align with the Los Angeles team (this overlap is a fixed requirement). During the initial ramp\-up period, new hires are also expected to be available for collaboration during daytime hours, approximately between 10:30 AM and 4:30 PM IST, with some flexibility. Candidates should be comfortable working a split schedule during the ramp\-up phase, with at least two hours of guaranteed overlap with the U.S. team.
   

  

**About Scopely**
 Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all\-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live\-operates one of the most diversified and award\-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.
   

  

 Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world\-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet\-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the \#1 mobile games company in the U.S. and \#2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.
   

  

 Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

title: Product Manager
description:
**About Refold AI** 




  





 Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants. 
 



  





 We've grown rapidly, reaching seven\-figure ARR and 30\+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM.
 



  





 Refold AI has raised $6\.5M from world\-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb \& Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.
 



  





**What you'll do:** 




  




* Where does automation earn trust, and where does a human still need to stay in the loop?
* You will draw that line repeatedly, and the answer will keep changing. How do you price outcomes instead of usage, in an industry that has only ever paid for hours? You will own that question commercially and build the model around it. What does it mean for a platform to get smarter across customers without leaking what any one customer knows?
* You will define what learning looks like at the system level.
* How do ISV developers think about reliability when their customers depend on
* integrations running without anyone watching? You will own that experience end to end.
* When something breaks in production for an enterprise customer, who gets told, what do they see, and what can they do about it? You will design that judgment layer.



  





**What we're looking for:** 




  




* You have shipped something on your own. A side project, a tool, anything you took from zero to working. We are building systems with real complexity. We need someone who has felt the difference between a decision made in a doc and a decision made in code.
* You are technically grounded. You do not write the code, but you understand the structure, the trade\-offs, and the failure modes. When engineering says a change costs 40% more compute, you know what that means downstream.
* You think in constraints. When you look at a feature request, the first question is what breaks if we build this, not what we could do with it. Edge cases are not polish. They are often the product.
* You write, not deck. Specs, trade\-off docs, design decisions. If you cannot write a crisp two\-page spec, the feature is not ready to build.
* You push back. If the scoping is underspecified, say so. If the deadline is not realistic, say so. Disagree clearly and commit once a decision is made



  





**Experience** 




  




* 5\+ years in product in the B2B software industry
* At least 2 of those years on a platform, infrastructure, or developer tool.
* Comfortable with distributed systems concepts: queues, retries, schema versioning, idempotency
* Track record of shipping things that were actually hard, not feature additions on a stable roadmap
* Degree from a top\-tier institution, or hands\-on product experience at a company known for building hard things. One or the other, not neither.

**About Cvent:** 




 www.cvent.com
 



  





 Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500\+ employees and \~30,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers human connection.
 



  





 Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone and Vista for $4\.6B in 2023\.
 



  





 Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
 



 Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human connection
 *.* 




  





**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**




 Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.
 



  





 Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
 



  





**Role Overview**




  





 As a Product Manager II, you will be responsible for the development and execution of our product vision with the help of cross\-functional teams through the entire product lifecycle. You will help with product research, roadmap prioritization, and work alongside engineers and designers to bring features to life. This is an ideal role for someone looking to grow in product management and gain hands\-on experience with a dynamic team.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




  




* Develop an in\-depth understanding of the business. products, including its goals and challenges, as well as a comprehensive knowledge of the customers and users of the platform. This involves analyzing their needs, behaviors, and pain points to ensure the product aligns with their expectations and delivers meaningful value.
* Contribute in product discovery by identifying customer pain points and market opportunities by conducting user research, gathering feedback, and analyzing data to support product decisions.
* Collaborate regularly with product managers on the future roadmap, brainstorm new ideas, and prioritize features, ensuring the backlog remains healthy, well\-organized, and aligned with business goals.
* Become a subject matter expert in your product domain, possessing in\-depth knowledge and insights that make you the primary point of contact for internal teams seeking guidance and collaboration.
* Develop detailed product specifications that begin by clearly articulating the “why” \- the core purpose and value behind the product, feature, or enhancements. These specifications should be thorough in addressing all necessary aspects yet written in a clear and concise manner to ensure they are easily understood by all stakeholders.
* Write comprehensive user stories with detailed acceptance criteria that address all functional and non\-functional aspects of the product, including security, data compliance, and other essential requirements.
* Work closely with engineering, design (UX/UI), and other stakeholders to ensure smooth product development and delivery. Also, ensure that all stakeholders are aligned with the product strategy and updates.
* Lead end\-to\-end product development process, from concept and design to development, testing, launch and ensuring timely and high\-quality delivery.
* Lead PI (Program Increment) planning and actively participate in key SCRUM ceremonies, including daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint planning, and product demos.
* Participate in go\-to\-market (GTM) strategies, product documentation, and feature releases to ensure successful product launches.
* Participate in beta programs and user testing sessions to gather direct feedback on product features and help iterate on future improvements.
* Should possess a solid grasp of technology platforms, integrations, and system design to collaborate effectively with engineering partners.
* Leverage the power of analytics and data\-driven intelligence to assess product performance, user behavior analysis, gather customer feedback, and insights from multiple channels, and make data\-informed decisions which enables you to drive excellence through iteration, improvement, and refinement.
* Monitor and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics to gauge the effectiveness, adoption, and product outcome.
* Share and present regular updates on the product roadmap and progress to leaders and stakeholders. Clearly highlight any potential risks and outline a plan to address them, ensuring everyone is informed and aligned on the path forward.
* Contribute to a culture of creativity and innovation within the product management team, think outside the box, explore new ideas, and identify opportunities to make our products stand out in the market.
* Proven ability to manage stakeholders effectively and influence cross\-functional teams without direct authority, fostering collaboration and driving alignment toward shared goals.



  





**What we are looking for:** 




  




* Minimum 9\-11 years of career experience with at least 7 years of product management (PO/PM) experience in technology products.
* Strong product sense with an ability to articulate problems and envision solutions.
* Strong understanding of technology and software development processes, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical teams.
* Inquisitive mindset with excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to manage competing and evolving priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to handle complex situations, conversations and navigate ambiguity.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence, partner and build relationships across all levels of the organization.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with an ability to communicate directly and clearly.

*Do You Dream Big?* 




*We Need You.* 




  





**Job Description** 




**Job Title:** 
 Product Manager
 



**Location:** 
 Bangalore
 



  





**PURPOSE OF ROLE** 




 BrewDat is ABI’s data platform, powering data products and AI solutions across all our domains – from sales and marketing to supply, finance, people, and more.
 



  





 We provide the data foundations, frameworks, and tools that enable teams across ABI to ingest, transform, govern, and serve data at scale \- following Data Mesh and Domain\-Driven Design principles.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We’re looking for a Product Manager with a strong technical background to lead the Integration products of BrewDat.
 



 Your main mission is to:
 


* Build and evolve the vision, strategy, and roadmap for BrewDat’s data engineering capabilities (ingestion, transformation, and serving).
* Understand and prioritize user needs from data engineers, analytics engineers, ML engineers, and domain teams.
* Turn complex platform capabilities into clear, usable products that make data teams more productive and autonomous.
* Build our Integration\-as\-a\-Service platform and guide the transition from legacy middleware to cloud\-native architectures



  





 You’ll work in a cross\-functional squad alongside engineers, a Delivery Manager, architects, and governance specialists, and you’ll collaborate closely with the Adoption team, who bring users’ needs to the product area.
 



  





**KEY TASKS AND ACCOUNTABILITIES** 



* **Product Strategy \& Vision**
* Define and evolve the product vision for BrewDat's data engineering layer (ingestion, transformation, and serving).
* Translate company and data strategy into a clear, prioritized roadmap for your squad.
* **Discovery \& User\-Centricity**
* Deeply understand the needs of data engineers, analytics engineers, domain squads, and internal platform users.
* Run product discovery: interviews, usage analysis, experiments, and feedback loops with internal customers.
* **Roadmap \& Delivery**
* Own and manage the product backlog for the Data Engineering squad.
* Write clear problem statements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, focusing on outcomes rather than outputs.
* Work in an Agile environment, participating in ceremonies and ensuring alignment between Product, Engineering, and Architecture.
* **Measurement \& Continuous Improvement**
* Define and track product KPIs: adoption, CSAT from users, build times, time\-to\-data, platform reliability, etc.
* Use data and feedback to continuously refine priorities and validate if shipped features are creating value.
* Promote a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement within the squad.
* **Stakeholder Management \& Communication**
* Align with multiple stakeholders (domains like sales, marketing, supply, finance, tech, etc.).
* Communicate roadmap, progress, trade\-offs, and impact clearly and frequently.
* Partner with the Adoption team to launch new capabilities, manage change, and scale usage.
* **Middleware**
* Managing the consolidated middleware roadmap, prioritizing global reliability frameworks (like cross\-zone replication/caching), and tracking integration unit economics (e.g., standardizing integration cost per application).

**Must\-Have** 



* Solid experience as a Product Manager (or Product Owner acting as PM) in:
* Data platforms, data engineering, analytics platforms, or developer/platform tools, or
* Technical products with strong infrastructure or backend components.
* Technical background (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Data, or equivalent experience). You don't need to code daily, but you must:
* Be comfortable discussing architecture, pipelines, and technical trade\-offs with engineers.
* Understand concepts like data pipelines, ETL/ELT, orchestration, data lakes, data warehouses, and APIs.
* Broaden the technical scope to include API management, event\-driven architectures, and microservices alongside the existing data pipeline concepts.



  





**Strong skills in:** 



* Product discovery and problem framing.
* Prioritization and roadmap management.
* Ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments, negotiate priorities, and align diverse interests.
* Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken).



  





**Nice\-to\-Have (Differentials)** 



* Experience with some of the technologies and concepts we use is a big plus, but not mandatory:
* Cloud \& Data: Azure, Databricks, Apache Spark, Airflow, Unity Catalog.
* Engineering Practices: GitHub, CI/CD, code review flows, Data Mesh.
* Experience with internal platforms or "products for developers/data teams" is especially valuable.
* Explicitly call out experience with legacy\-to\-cloud migrations (e.g., MuleSoft to Camel\-K), Azure DevOps for delivery tracking, and deep observability tools like Datadog.



  





*And above all of this, an undying love for beer!* 




*We dream big to create future with more cheers*

Syndigo powers the continual flow of data and content throughout the entire commerce ecosystem— accelerating delivery of accurate and compelling information that increases sales on every shelf.  Syndigo serves the industry’s largest two\-sided network, connecting more than 50,000 global users across 12,000\+ global brands with more than 1,750 global retailers.
 



 Basically, we're the people that deliver the rich, accurate product content that helps consumers shop online with confidence, and helps brands and retailers operate efficient product supply chains. We cannot do all of this without our amazing employees who make the magic happen here at Syndigo. As we continue to grow, we’re always looking to identify talented individuals to join our team.
 



  
 



**Product Manager**

 We are looking for a Product Manager who embraces an AI\-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC), using AI throughout the product lifecycle to accelerate innovation, improve product quality, and deliver measurable customer outcomes. You will use AIDLC to lead the strategy and execution of capabilities across our Product Experience Management (PXM) platform while identifying opportunities to automate workflows, improve data quality, and enhance customer productivity at scale.

description:
**About us:**  

Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.  

  

Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.  

  

Target’s distinctive brand love is infused throughout its many physical locations by the Properties teams. We have a direct and positive impact on the real estate, design, construction and maintenance of our 2000\+ **stores, distribution centers and headquarters**. Target invests 75% of annual capital investment into Properties, and over half of the enterprise OpEx, leading to significant opportunity to impact outcomes for the business. We have an ambitious goal to launch hundreds of new stores over the next 10 years, with several hundred more remodels in stores, all driving new customers and incremental sales for Target.  

  

Are you ready to help strategically grow Target’s brand through leading\-edge design, development, construction and preservation? Can you effectively balance the efficiencies of a large\-design build company with the unique challenges and innovative solutions required by individual sites? Then take your place as a Product Manager on Target Properties Product team and help us make the most of Target’s physical footprint both in the U.S. and overseas.  

  

Product Teams at Target Corporation are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable. Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all product, technology and design work.  

  

As a Product Manager – GSCL Maintenance Operations, you will own the day\-to\-day product management for the work delivered in partnership with the Target in India Product Engineering team.  

  

This is a unique opportunity to help modernize Target’s Global Supply Chain Asset Management as part of a multi\-year transformation by moving from a highly customized legacy system to industry\-standard, out\-of\-the\-box Enterprise Asset Management capabilities for our Supply Chain Teams. The transformation will establish a more scalable and sustainable foundation for asset lifecycle visibility, standardized maintenance workflows, mobile execution, safety, workforce planning and scheduling, materials and inventory management, asset health, and predictive maintenance. This work will help reduce downtime, improve maintenance productivity, strengthen data quality and transparency, and enable better total\-cost\-of\-ownership decisions across Target’s supply chain network.  

  

Over the next several years, the team will establish the new Asset Management foundation and launch and scale across the network to eventually enable advanced asset\-health and predictive\-maintenance capabilities.  

  

As a Product Manager, you will work in the product model and will collaborate with your product team and key stakeholders to develop a plan and business objectives (OKRs) for your respective product. You will need to build a strong knowledge of your product through product discovery to collect customer feedback and work to collect other relevant data points that explain the value and help you prioritize the direction and desired outcomes for your product. You will work in unison with engineers, UX designers, data scientists and business partners to deliver a product.  

  

You will be the “voice of the product” with your product team and stakeholders to ensure that their needs are met, and you will be responsible to maintain and refine the product backlog (create user stories \& acceptance criteria) while prioritizing the backlog to focus on the highest impact work for your team and stakeholders.  

  

You will encourage the open exchange of information and viewpoints, as well as inspire others to achieve challenging goals and high standards of performance while committing to the organization's direction. You will foster sense of urgency to achieve goals and leverage resources to overcome unexpected obstacles.  

  

Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.  

  

**About you:*** Four\-year degree or equivalent experience
* 2\+ years of product management and/or equivalent domain experience
* Experience working in an agile environment (e.g. user stories, iterative development, scrum teams, sprints, personas, UI discovery and development)
* Strong facilitation skills that guide groups towards productive outcomes while maintaining a positive and collaborative atmosphere
* Demonstrated ability to bridge business and technical teams
* Curiosity with a passion for learning and contributing to a growth culture
* Product management experience in Asset Management/ Maintenance Management, or stores /properties experience preferred

description:
**About Auric AI** 




 Auric AI is developing the world's most advanced AI\-powered vision intelligence platform for defense applications
 



 Defense and military organizations today receive overwhelming volumes of visual data from satellites and drones. Processing this manually is slow, expensive, and error\-prone. Our mission is to use AI\-powered vision systems to detect and classify high\-value military objects such as tanks, artillery, radars, and missile launchers so analysts and commanders can act faster and with greater confidence.
 



  





 We’re a fast\-moving defense technology startup, combining world\-class AI research with real\-world military applications to create intelligence platforms that can make a difference where time and trust matter most.
 



**The Role** 




 We’re hiring a Product Manager to lead the development of our Vision Intelligence Platform.
 



 This is not a traditional PM role. You will:
 


* Think from first principles to design workflows that make AI useful in mission\-critical contexts.
* Translate AI research into usable, analyst\-facing products.
* Balance speed, trust, and usability when making product decisions.
* Be AI\-native using the latest AI tools to build wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and demo flows at speed.
* You will own the end\-to\-end product experience: defining workflows, designing intuitive screens, prioritizing features, and ensuring analysts receive intelligence they can trust all within minutes of image arrival.



**What You’ll Do** 



* Vision \& Roadmap


1. Define the product vision and articulate a clear north star for the platform.
2. Build and communicate a roadmap balancing near\-term MVP delivery with long\-term platform growth.


* Workflow \& UX Design


1. Map the full analyst journey: image ingestion → preprocessing → AI detection → quality review → database → dissemination.
2. Work with engineers and designers to create intuitive, analyst\-ready screens.
3. Use AI\-powered tools (e.g., Figma plugins, AI prototyping, AI design assistants) to generate wireframes and demo flows rapidly.


* Feature Prioritization


1. Define MVP scope and ruthlessly separate must\-haves from nice\-to\-haves.
2. Make trade\-offs between speed\-to\-decision, detection accuracy, and user trust.


* Execution \& Delivery


1. Translate requirements into clear PRDs and product specs.
2. Drive collaboration between AI researchers, engineers, and domain experts.
3. Ensure reliability and quality in product releases.


* User \& Stakeholder Engagement


1. Engage with analysts, retired officers, and other stakeholders to understand workflows.
2. Synthesize fragmented feedback into coherent product direction.


* Metrics \& Success


1. Define and track success metrics: time\-to\-insight, adoption, accuracy, and trust in outputs.
2. Use feedback and data to iterate rapidly.



**What We’re Looking For** 



* AI\-native builder: highly proficient in using AI tools for prototyping, wireframing, and creating demo flows.
* First principles thinker who simplifies complex problems into clear workflows.
* Technical fluency: understand how AI and software systems work, even if you don’t code daily.
* User empathy: can design for non\-technical users working under pressure.
* Execution strength: bias for rapid prototyping, iteration, and delivery.
* Communication skills: able to align researchers, engineers, and defense users.
* Prior startup/founder experience or exposure to AI/ML products is a strong plus.



**Why Join Us** 



* Work on one of the hardest, most impactful problems in defense AI.
* Collaborate with a small, world\-class team of researchers and engineers.
* High ownership from day one shapes the platform, not just maintains it.
* Move fast, learn fast, we build, test, and iterate aggressively.
* Be part of a mission\-driven company where AI meets national security.



 Auric AI is building the future of defense intelligence. If you’re an AI\-native product builder who thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-ownership environment, we’d love to hear from you.

 Amazon Pay is seeking an innovative and highly motivated Product leader to reimagine the future of credit and lending in India. We are looking for an experienced Product leader who loves listening to customers, uncovering stated and unstated problems and finding the right product experiences to solve these problems.
   

  

 A Product leader at Amazon is an entrepreneur. You will articulate compelling user stories, crisply define customer and product requirements, own the product roadmap, and refine specifications and architecture through the product lifecycle. You will work closely with design, engineering, data sciences, project management and legal teams in an agile environment to launch products and scale them to tens of millions of customers. You will work with marketing, sales, business development, finance, and account management teams to drive the adoption of your product and further refine features and functionality basis live customer feedback. You will be accountable for ensuring that the product complies with external regulation, and the operating processes and systems you setup are scalable.
   

  

 A successful candidate will be a self\-starter with excellent business acumen \& vision, product \& program management skills, and a highly effective people leader who can work in a highly ambiguous environment. You will bring a heightened sense of ownership, thought leadership and product building expertise to a fast\-pace start\-up environment, and you will be partnering with technology teams and stakeholders across Amazon to drive business outcomes.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager (L6\) to drive usage and engagement on APL — growing activity rates, deepening consumption, and simplifying the discovery, usage, and repayment experience, all while keeping abuse and fraud in check. This is a high\-impact, data\-intensive role requiring close partnership with lender, technology, marketing, and customer service teams.
   

  

* Grow activity \& usage — Improve activity rates and transaction frequency across customer segments through product interventions spanning discovery, usage, and repayment.

title: Manager - Customer Experience and Communications
description:
**About Snapmint:** 




 Snapmint is a leading fintech company redefining access to consumer credit in India. With over 10 million customers across 2,200\+ cities, our zero\-cost EMI platform enables responsible purchases without the need for a credit card across categories like fashion, electronics, and lifestyle. India has over 300 million credit eligible consumers, yet fewer than 35 million actively use credit cards. Snapmint addresses this gap by offering a trusted, transparent alternative grounded in financial inclusion and ethical lending practices.
 



  





 Founded in 2017, Snapmint is a profitable, high\-growth company doubling year\-on\-year. Our founding team, alumni of IIT Bombay and ISB, brings deep experience from companies like Oyo, Ola, Maruti Suzuki, and has successfully built and exited ventures in ad\-tech, patent analytics, and bank\-tech.We are building the future of responsible consumer finance, simple, transparent, and customer\-first.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 Snapmint’s CRM engine is analytically deep and built for measurement. We’re now adding a new layer: a dedicated owner of customer experience, narrative, and insight that complements the numbers with genuine human understanding.
 



  





 As Manager – Customer Experience \& Communications, you will be the voice of the customer inside the lifecycle team. You’ll define how we communicate across every touchpoint, run deep customer research to uncover why users behave the way they do, and translate those insights into sharper messaging, better journeys, and a more empathetic brand presence. This is not a pure analytics role — it’s a creative, research\-led, customer\-obsessed position designed to sit alongside our data\-driven CRM managers and make the whole system stronger
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 ● Customer Experience Strategy \& Journey Communications Own the communication layer across push, SMS, WhatsApp, email, and IVR. Build messaging playbooks for each lifecycle stage — from onboarding to reactivation — and ensure a consistent, human tone across all user touchpoints.
 



 ● Customer Research \& Insights Conduct qualitative and quantitative research to understand user motivations, pain points, and drop\-offs. Bring the voice of the customer into campaign design. Partner with analytics to connect behavioural data with underlying intent, and turn those insights into better messaging and experience improvements.
 



 ● Creative \& Narrative Development Translate data\-led journey maps into clear, compelling, and empathetic communication. Craft the narratives for activation, engagement, cross\-sell, win\-back, and rewards campaigns. Test messaging, tone, and creative approaches through A/B experiments, and refine based on performance and customer feedback.
 



 ● Cross\-Functional Partnership Work closely with lifecycle managers, campaign specialists, product teams, and design. Brief creative needs, review output for quality and consistency, and champion the customer perspective in every room you’re in.
 



  





**Requirements:** 




 ● 3–6 years of experience in customer experience, brand marketing, lifecycle communications, or a similar role where you shaped customer narratives.
 



 ● Strong writing and communication skills — you can craft messaging that feels human, not robotic
 



 ● Experience with CRM or engagement platforms ( CleverTap , MoEngage , WebEngage , or Similar) — you don’t need to build complex journeys, but you understand the canvas you’re working on.
 



 ● Comfort with campaign data and performance metrics — you don’t need to be an analyst, but you can read a campaign dashboard and use it to inform creative decisions.
 



 ● Hands\-on exposure to customer research or insight generation — you’ve run interviews, surveys, or usability studies, or worked closely with researchers.
 



 ● A natural empathy for users and a curiosity about what drives behaviour.
 



 ● Prior work in consumer internet or fintech is a strong plus.

**Description**
 Amazon's Emerging Markets (EM10\) serve hundreds of millions of customers across India, Brazil, Mexico, Middle East, Turkey, Australia, Singapore, and South Africa. Yet a majority of these customers remain unsettled \- they shop infrequently, lapse quickly, and never build the habits that unlock Amazon's full value. Settling these customers represents a $5B\-$7B incremental opportunity across EMs. The IES Lifecycle Experiences (ILX) team exists to solve this problem \- programmatically and efficiently progressing customers through their engagement with Amazon, from first purchase to settled Prime membership.
   

  

 We are seeking a senior product and business leader to own this charter end\-to\-end. You will lead a team of product managers, marketers, and program managers building the systems, experiences, and intelligence that drive customer settlement at scale. Your products today reach 140MM\+ customers annually and operate across all 10 emerging marketplaces. Your charter spans four interconnected programs: a deferred micro\-currency and rewards system that drives longitudinal habit formation ("Diamonds"); a behavioral engagement engine using streaks, missions, and gamified mechanics to build shopping habits; an AI\-native orchestration platform that replaces manual marketer judgment with autonomous, ML\-driven campaign execution; and the underlying ML models that optimize who gets rewarded, with what, and when \- across hundreds of millions in annual incentive spend.
   

  

 This role demands a rare combination \- someone who can build conviction on long\-horizon product bets while delivering measurable quarterly results; who can architect ML\-powered systems while staying grounded in customer psychology and behavioral economics; and who can lead cross\-functional teams spanning product, science, marketing, and engineering across geographies. You will operate at the intersection of product strategy, applied machine learning, and marketing science \- in a space where the playbook is being written, not followed. If you are energized by building category\-defining products that serve hundreds of millions of customers, and want to architect the system that turns Amazon's largest untapped customer base into its most engaged, this role is for you.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end lifecycle progression strategy across EM10 \- from product vision and 3\-year roadmap through quarterly goal setting, experimentation cadence, and P\&L accountability.
* Drive settlement outcomes for 140MM\+ customers through a unified toolkit of rewards, gamified experiences, and ML\-powered orchestration.
* Build and scale an autonomous marketing orchestration platform \- defining the product architecture where marketers input objectives and budgets, and the system selects audiences, deploys optimal campaign mixes, dynamically allocates rewards, and optimizes performance in real\-time with minimal human intervention.
* Drive a cross\-EM rewards program \- scaling across 10 markets, managing program economics (earn rates, breakage, external funding), and evolving the construct from transactional lift to longitudinal habit formation. Own measurement rigor including causal incrementality frameworks for novel, longitudinal customer experiences.
* Lead the progression intelligence roadmap \- partnering with science teams to evolve ML models that determine the right action, the right reward amount, and the right timing per customer. Drive adoption across categories and deliver incremental revenue through ML\-optimized reward allocation.
* Build and mentor a high\-performing, multi\-disciplinary team (product, marketing, program management), partnering marketing orgs across IN/LATAM/MENA \- setting the bar for analytical rigor, customer obsession, and bias for action in a charter where most of the playbook is being invented.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 6\+ years of team management experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience delivering consumer software products and services in a high growth environment

description:
**This is where** 
 your work makes a difference.
   

  

 At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.
   

  

 Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.
   

  

 Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Baxter’s Front Line Care business unit products expand therapies to better help patients and physicians to monitor \& manage chronic or acute respiratory and cardiac diseases (COPD, CHF, etc.). The earlier the treatment for these patients – the better the quality of life. The $1\.1B business portfolio includes products for airway clearance, cardiology \& patient monitors.
   

  

 You will be responsible for the overall technical direction and deliverables for Front Line Care products. Based on your significant technical expertise and leadership skills, you will also drive the full product development cycle from feasibility through lifecycle management. Assures that quality is built into the design during new product development. Proactively monitors the program and develops strategies to mitigate technical risks. Report on the progress on a routine cadence to senior management.
   

  

 The role of
 **Principal Engineer** 
 includes responsibility for developing creative solutions to challenging issues associated with the design, development, and sustaining engineering for our new and existing Front line care product portfolio. Possess solid “hands\-on” technical abilities, an excitement and energy for product development, and a passion for the work and the impact it has on meeting the needs of patients. In addition, you will also be responsible for application of human factors engineering principles to the design, development, and testing of medical products while working with cross\-functional program teams. This position is based out of Bangalore and reporting to the Manager, Systems Front\-Line Care.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* As a Principal Engineer Systems, responsible for end\-to\-end development \& sustenance of the product, from capturing the user/marketing needs to final product release. Interact with customers and marketing to develop and refine user requirements.
* System engineering plays a critical role in product development, making sure the product meets all the functional and performance requirements. He/ She is responsible for making sure the manufacturing and service requirements are translated into product design.
* Lead the development and documentation of the product systems architecture and systems level design, including the decomposition of the system architecture and requirements into subsystem and interface specifications.
* Hands on Experience and knowledge in requirements of IEC62366, 60601\-1, IEC62304 and associated guidance’s from FDA, EU MDR.
* Resolve competing constraints between interrelated functions (engineering, manufacturing, regulatory, marketing, etc.) required to deliver the product to market.
* Plan and execute system integration activities to minimize issues in systems verification and validation.
* Document traceability from requirements to verification activities, and from requirements to design entities.
* Resolve system\-related technical issues by applying problem solving tools such as cause\-and\-effect diagrams and Pareto charts
* Adheres to Baxter Quality Management system \& supports the quality audits.
* Plan, coordinate, perform, analyze and document study activities with focus on identifying user needs, intended user profiles, use environment and usability aspects.
* Analyze and define goals and requirements related to usability for the products.
* Plan, coordinate, perform, visualize and document concept of handling design
* Plan, perform and document evaluations of handling related product risks.
* Plan, perform, analyze and document usability evaluation activities according to scientifically accepted tools
* Identify and implement improvements to the internal processes within the competence area to secure that state of art is maintained
* Support in audits and assessments made by authorities and third parties
* Time and budget estimations for Human Factors activities where one or several resources are assigned.
* Identify and define internal and external customer needs, functions, performance, usability and safety requirement for product or solution with thorough knowledge and understanding constraints \- Business and Regulatory, Design trade\-offs and Risk assessment early in the development cycle working independently or under the guidance of senior staff.
* Excels in the development of Use Case for product or solution based on intimate knowledge of customers and their environments.
* Use tools such as DOORS and excels in the management of requirements and decomposition of system level requirements to modules.
* Carry out risk management process in accordance with the EN ISO 14971 throughout product life cycle to ensure compliance and product safety.
* Completes detailed, high\-quality technical documentation to capture and communicate designs.
* As Lead integrator for the product proactively look out for integration issues during development tests and ensure module / system development is successful.
* Actively engage with verification and validation engineers to aid in the development of verification scripts with good test coverage


**What You’ll Bring**
* Graduate or Post\-Graduate in Electrical, Mechanical, Biomedical, or related Engineering.
* An advanced technical degree is desired. Experience should include at least 8\-12 years of relevant technical experience, including some technical leadership.
* Must possess a strong knowledge of engineering disciplines like Risk Management and Usability / Human Factors Engineering and solid knowledge of related disciplines, Electro/Mechanical, Systems, Fluid Mechanics, Materials Science, blowers, pumps, and control systems
* Experience in Medical Device Development, FDA Regulations and MDR.
* Demonstrated excellent skills in Human Factors Engineering techniques.
* Demonstrated understanding and capabilities within user centered design.

**Client Leadership \& Delivery Ownership**

* Experience working directly with senior business and technical stakeholders to translate requirements into architecture, roadmaps, and delivered solutions.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts, risks, dependencies, and trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated experience leading engineers, reviewing designs and code, and driving accountability across delivery teams.
* Strong ownership mindset with a focus on client outcomes, delivery rigor, and continuous improvement.


**Good\-to\-Have Skills**

* Exposure to search and analytics platforms such as Elasticsearch/OpenSearch and graph databases such as Neo4j.
* Experience with Kubernetes, GitOps, infrastructure as code, and advanced cloud\-native engineering patterns.
* Cloud certifications across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Familiarity with ML frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.
* Experience supporting proposals, technical demos, proofs of concept, or early\-stage solution shaping in consulting or client\-facing environments.


**Work You Will Do**

* Lead the design, development, and deployment of high\-quality cybersecurity and AI\-enabled solutions aligned to client requirements, enterprise architecture, and security expectations.
* Own technical delivery across one or more workstreams, including planning, architecture, issue resolution, quality management, and execution oversight.
* Guide engineering teams through solution design, implementation, testing, deployment, and post\-launch stabilization.

title: Lead Product Manager
description:
**About Rippling** 




 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
 



 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
 



**Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.85B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.** 




  





**We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.** 




  





**About the role** 



* Every year, employers and employees spend more than $5 trillion on benefits globally. These products—from health insurance and retirement to fertility, mental health, telemedicine, and financial wellness—shape some of the most important decisions families make. Yet discovering, purchasing, and managing them remains fragmented, expensive, and confusing.
* Rippling is building the first modern benefits marketplace that connects brokers, employers, employees, and benefit providers in one platform. Our benefits vertical includes the Rippling Benefits Platform, a rapidly growing marketplace of more than 100 partners, Rippling\-native benefits products, and Rippling PEO.
* We are looking for a Growth Product Lead, Benefits Marketplace \& PEO to turn these product assets into a scaled growth engine. You will own the strategy and product roadmap to unlock growth by expanding the customers and benefit categories Rippling can serve. This role will play a central role increasing marketplace adoption and revenue.
* This is a highly cross\-functional, zero\-to\-one role at the intersection of product, growth and go\-to\-market. You will work with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, Benefits Advisors, Business Development and Operations,. Success will be measured in business outcomes—including qualified demand, funnel conversion and revenue and not only in features shipped.



  





**What you'll do** 



* Own the growth strategy and corresponding product roadmap for the Benefits Marketplace and PEO, with a clear mandate to expand the addressable market.
* Execute product led growth plan across benefit categories, geographies, employer profiles, and distribution channels.
* Expand the marketplace's addressable market by identifying and prioritizing new customer segments based on unmet demand, revenue potential, strategic deal unlocks, and Rippling's right to win.
* Expand awareness and consideration for the Benefits Marketplace by improving how employers discover, understand, compare, and evaluate relevant benefits.
* Accelerate PEO top\-of\-funnel growth by increasing awareness, improving education and discovery, and creating high\-intent entry points that generate and qualify demand across organic, in\-product, partner, broker, and sales\-led channels.
* Expand PEO's TAM by identifying customer profiles and market opportunities Rippling does not serve well today, then shaping the positioning, packaging, product entry points, and cross\-functional investments needed to reach them.
* Translate the growth strategy into clear product requirements, prioritized bets, channel plans, and measurable top\-of\-funnel experiments—while partnering closely with downstream owners on clean handoffs and shared learning.



  





**What you will need** 



* 8\+ years of product management experience, including meaningful ownership of growth in B2B products.
* A track record of delivering measurable business outcomes—such as revenue, conversion, retention, attach, adoption, supply growth — through a combination of product and go\-to\-market levers.
* Strong product judgment and commercial instincts: You can connect customer problems, market dynamics and growth strategy into coherent product capabilities.
* Excellent analytical skills: You can define a funnel, build a business case, segment customers and partners, evaluate experiments, and turn ambiguous data into clear decisions.
* Customer obsession: You are equally comfortable speaking with employers, employees, brokers, partners, sales teams, and operations —and translating their needs into scalable products.
* Strong technical fluency and systems thinking. You can work effectively with engineers on data models, integrations, AI\-powered workflows, operational tooling, and platform capabilities without losing sight of the customer or business outcome.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to align executives and cross\-functional teams around a strategy, metrics, priorities, and tradeoffs.
* A self\-starter with a bias toward action who thrives in a fast\-moving environment, creates clarity from ambiguity, and can shift between long\-range strategy and detailed execution.
* Experience in benefits, insurance, PEO, payroll, marketplaces, partner ecosystems, or B2B2C products is a strong plus.
* Founder or hypergrowth startup experience is a strong plus.
* Strong alignment with Rippling's leadership principles, especially Go and See and Are Right, a Lot.
