title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 The Oracle Health
 **Medication Administration** 
 team is responsible for delivering solutions that help clinicians safely and efficiently administer medications across acute, ambulatory, and specialty care settings. Medication administration is one of the most critical moments in the care delivery process, directly impacting patient safety, clinical outcomes, regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, and clinician experience.
   

  

 Our mission is to support and evolve medication administration workflows through intuitive, reliable, and highly integrated solutions that reduce cognitive burden, streamline nursing workflows, and improve patient safety. This includes maintaining existing medication administration capabilities that customers depend on today, while also modernizing traditional workflows through interoperability, mobile experiences, barcode medication administration, clinical decision support, workflow optimization, and emerging AI\-enabled capabilities.
   

  

 We are seeking a
 **Senior Product Manager** 
 to help manage, enhance, and modernize medication administration capabilities within Oracle Health’s Electronic Health Record. In this role, you will balance support for existing and legacy product capabilities with the development of new workflows, modernization initiatives, and future\-state medication administration experiences.
   

  

 You will partner closely with nursing leaders, pharmacists, physicians, customers, engineering teams, UX designers, clinical informaticists, quality, regulatory, consulting, and customer\-facing teams to deliver solutions that improve the safety, efficiency, usability, and reliability of medication administration workflows.
   

  

 You will be responsible for understanding customer needs, defining product requirements, prioritizing investments, supporting roadmap execution, and guiding product development from concept through delivery and adoption. This role requires a product manager who can operate across current\-state product support, customer commitments, regulatory and safety expectations, technical modernization, and future\-state product innovation.
   

  

 Your work will directly impact clinicians caring for patients every day while helping Oracle Health advance the next generation of medication management.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Product Strategy, Roadmap, and Portfolio Execution: Contribute to the strategic direction and roadmap for medication administration capabilities across the Oracle Health platform. Balance enhancement requests, customer commitments, regulatory needs, technical debt, customer feedback, defects, lifecycle considerations, and modernization investments across both existing and future\-state product capabilities.
* Existing Product Support and Lifecycle Management: Support the ongoing evolution of existing and legacy medication administration capabilities that are currently used by Oracle Health customers. Evaluate customer issues, workflow gaps, adoption barriers, technical constraints, and lifecycle needs to inform prioritization, sustainment decisions, modernization plans, and customer communication.
* Product Requirements and Feature Definition: Translate customer needs, clinical workflow requirements, regulatory expectations, modernization priorities, and market opportunities into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and workflow documentation. Partner closely with engineering and UX teams throughout the development lifecycle to ensure requirements are actionable, testable, and aligned to product intent.
* Clinical Workflow Expertise: Develop deep understanding of medication administration workflows, including barcode medication administration, medication scanning, medication scheduling, infusion management, documentation, exception handling, medication safety checks, and clinical communication. Ensure solutions align with real\-world nursing practice across both current customer workflows and future\-state product experiences.
* Customer and User Engagement: Engage with customers, external stakeholders, and internal stakeholders to understand workflow challenges, ensure product capabilities align with customer needs, gather feedback, and support adoption. Act as the voice of the customer while balancing individual customer needs with scalable product direction.
* Patient Safety and Quality Focus: Champion patient safety by identifying opportunities to reduce medication errors, improve compliance with medication administration policies, strengthen documentation quality, and enhance decision support during medication administration workflows. Ensure product decisions appropriately account for clinical risk, usability, reliability, and safety in high\-stakes care settings.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering, UX, clinical informatics, interoperability, quality assurance, regulatory, consulting, support, customer success, and customer\-facing teams to deliver high\-quality solutions that meet customer and market needs. Drive alignment across stakeholders when priorities, ownership, dependencies, or tradeoffs are unclear.
* Workflow Modernization and Innovation: Drive modernization initiatives focused on improving usability, mobility, automation, workflow efficiency, and product scalability. Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI and intelligent automation, to identify opportunities that create measurable value for clinicians while maintaining trust, safety, and operational readiness.
* Regulatory and Compliance Alignment: Ensure product capabilities support applicable healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, medication safety practices, privacy, security, and documentation requirements. Partner with regulatory, quality, clinical safety, and engineering stakeholders to ensure both existing and new capabilities remain aligned with evolving compliance expectations.
* Product Delivery, Release Readiness, and Adoption: Support release planning, dependency tracking, customer readiness, documentation, training, enablement, and adoption strategies. Measure outcomes and continuously improve products based on customer feedback, support trends, usage data, workflow observations, and product performance metrics.
* Market and Industry Awareness: Maintain awareness of healthcare industry trends, nursing informatics practices, medication safety initiatives, competitor offerings, interoperability standards, and evolving technology expectations. Use market and customer insights to inform roadmap decisions, modernization priorities, and investment recommendations.


**Qualifications**
 Career Level \- IC3
   

  

**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
   

  

 True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. title: AI and Data-Technical Product Manager-VG-CDAO0266
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Technology Consulting**
**Title: Specialist III, Technical Product Manager**
 EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
   

  

 Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**EY Technology:**
 Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
   

  

**EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:**
* Client Technology (CT) \- focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology\-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
* Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit\-for\-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
* Information Security (Info Sec) \- Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber\-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.


**The opportunity**
 This role leads the strategic vision and roadmap for a technical product or products within a specific business area, demonstrating a deep understanding of the product(s). Products may have enterprise\-wide implications. This role also uses market insights to evaluate product functionality and informs the future product direction based on consumer trends and product performance.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Leads technical product management activities for multiple technical products, or one strategic technical product. Participates in the design and continuous improvement of the technical solution.
* Collaborates with cross\-functional teams to create best practices that drive significant change to the client experience.
* Coaches’ technical product teams towards best practices and learnings. Ensures delivery of messaging, communication, and customer outreach as necessary.
* Partners with stakeholders to resolve production and implementation issues in a timely manner, and supports/drives escalations where required to enable rapid delivery.
* Leads the planning, development and implementation of new technical products. Defines and analyzes technical markets, developing detailed product features and requirements, and developing implementation plans.
* Employs a variety of qualitative and quantitative analysis techniques to continually improve the user experience.
* Participates in and provides recommendations for ongoing business planning and departmental prioritization activities.
* Participates in the team’s engineering practices in development, continuous integration, and automated deployment.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Manages the entire product life cycle from planning to execution in alignment with business goals and strategy.
* Researches and analyzes market conditions to identify key consumer trends and opportunities for product enhancements or innovation.
* Determines product features and functions by gathering business and customer feedback and translating it into product requirements.
* Prepares product documentation and supports go\-to\-market activities by providing product knowledge to sales and marketing teams.
* Leverages market and performance feedback to evaluate product effectiveness and steer future product direction.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Minimum 8 years of experience in technical product management, with at least 2 years leading large cross\-functional teams. Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field required; graduate degree preferred.
* Good to have skills in product lifecycle management, market analysis, product design, user experience evaluation, technical documentation, and cross\-functional stakeholder collaboration. Technical knowledge in software development processes, APIs, cloud platforms, or data\-driven product environments is important.
* Strong communication, strategic thinking, problem\-solving, and project execution skills.
* Preferred certifications include Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Pragmatic Institute Product Management Certifications, or SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager (POPM). Ability to balance technical feasibility with business viability and user desirability is essential.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship\-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)


**What We Look For**
* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well\-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

 Client Services provides industry\-leading operational support to Visa’s clients around the world. With our deep knowledge and expertise, we bring the voice of the customer into the design, development and successful deployment of Visa products and services. We are trusted partners to Visa’s clients, providing expertise to support and successfully grow their business.

We enable Client and Client Services teams to successfully deploy and support products solutions in a consistent, scalable as well as repeatable way across Asia Pacific (AP) region.
   

  

 This role is responsible for delivering services and enabling complex initiatives that lack predefined instructions, through individual contributions and matrix management. It includes partnering with Product teams to understand the strategic roadmap and interpreting and communicating both Client Services priorities and client needs. This role holder will be defining the support and implementation plan, executing initial pilot clients or use cases and defining a plan to migrate support to core Client Services teams with a focus on operational efficiency and scaling to support the product pipeline.
   

  

**In This Role, You Are Expected To**
* Design and enable delivery of a scalable, repeatable and effective client service experience from implementation to support for new products and solutions, while anticipating and planning for deviations to intended experience
* Define transition plans to migrate support to wider Client Services teams with a focus on operational efficiency and optimization
* Partner with Product and Technology teams to develop artifacts, training materials and presentations for the Client Services team
* Be the primary liaison with various Product and Technology team to identify client impacts, support and implementation gaps, assist in resolution of gaps prior to product rollouts
* Manage and execute new product and solutions pilot deployment, lead as Project manager to coordinate directly with pilot clients to analyze services and platform requirements to support the business and formulate implementation solutions

* Stay current with industry and client trends and maintain a strong knowledge of Visa products and services
* Embrace and implement new methodologies on an ongoing basis as the business scales within the organization
* Responsible for own workflow assignments and must be able to be a fast responder and be proactive in resolving problems and meeting deadlines
* Constantly create good functional collaboration with internal and external stakeholders
* Be an active contributor in the creation of a high\-performing, supportive, and inclusive team culture.


**Why This Is Important To Visa**
 The Visa Acceptance Platform, also known as Cybersource, is an important part of Visa’s Value\-Added Services and broader payments ecosystem. This role supports Visa’s strategy by helping clients successfully implement and adopt Cybersource solutions, while designing consistent and scalable service experiences from implementation through post\-launch support. By partnering with Product, Technology, Client Services, and clients, the role helps strengthen implementation readiness, improve the client experience, and support Visa’s continued growth in digital payments and acceptance solutions.
   

  

 Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 What you will need:
   

  

**About**
 We are looking for an individual who brings breadth of experience, a curiosity about payments, is results\-driven and client focused. As a candidate, you should have:
   

  

* Bachelor’s Degree with at least 8\+ years of experience in product or project management or product development in the payments industry
* Functional project management experience in a client facing role
* Working knowledge of core transaction processing (message routing, authorization, clearing and settlement)
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to absorb technical information and apply to business solutions where little or no precedence exists. Be able to communicate complex, technical concepts in a focused and well\-organized manner
* Willingness to take on new challenges in a fast\-paced environment and be flexible with multi\-tasking and changing priorities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, problem solving skills, attention to detail and interpersonal skills in negotiating and influencing internal and external stakeholders
* Organized self\-starter, client\-centric, analytic, collaborative, understands and can translate complex issues and speaking to impact and priority
* Excellent client engagement and relationship management skills with collaborative approach to stakeholder management
* Be able to learn and acquire knowledge in new technologies in keeping step with market developments


**What Will Also Help**
* Subject Matter Expertise in multiple areas such as card payments, products and services, payment technologies, wallet services gained through years of experience supporting clients and new product initiatives within a payment\-processing environment
* Experience of working with Issuers, Acquirers, and Processors in the Asia Pacific region
* Team collaboration demonstrated by desire and willingness to share knowledge with a broader team, be receptive to new ideas and changes to the standard operational procedures

 This is an incredibly exciting time to join the AP Go\-To\-Market Services team. title: Product Manager
description:
12 of the top 15 pharma generic companies in the world trust Leucine to manufacture the drugs that reach millions of patients every day.
   

  

 Pharma manufacturing is one of the last large industries still running on paper, Excel, and tribal knowledge. A single missed step in a batch record can mean a recall, a regulatory warning, or a drug that should never have left the plant.
   

  

 Leucine is the AI platform replacing all of it. Series A, backed by top\-tier global investors, 60\+ pharma enterprises in production, and the team that's going to define this category.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You will deploy and run our platform inside pharma customers with your own hands, and be the product manager for the platform based on what that teaches you. You'll model a customer's QC and manufacturing data, build the pipelines, ontology, and apps (directing our AI agents to do the heavy lifting — and verifying everything they produce), and get real users live. Then you'll turn the friction and gaps you hit in the field into the product roadmap, working directly with the CPO.
   

  

 This is the shortest path from a customer's real problem to a shipped platform improvement. It suits a technical builder who is genuinely comfortable in SQL and data models, skeptical and sharp when reviewing AI output, and obsessed with getting the data right.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Deploy the platform at customers (hands\-on)
   

  

* Model the customer's data end\-to\-end: build source→gold data pipelines (transforms, joins, incremental loads, dedup, grain, schema drift) and design the business ontology — entities (batch records, deviations, QC results, instruments, sampling, etc.), their relationships, and how they map to the customer's real source columns
* Write and debug SQL against the data warehouse; validate correctness with dry\-runs, row counts, and spec checks before anything reaches a user
* Build operational apps and dashboards on the platform for customer users (data bindings, platform components), and drive adoption with quality/manufacturing stakeholders
* Troubleshoot pipeline, data\-model, and app issues to root cause — across the data, the generated artifacts, and logs


 Operate and verify AI agents
   

  

* Direct the platform's AI agents to generate pipelines, data models, and apps — and rigorously review their output: read the generated SQL/specs, catch silent failures (all\-zero dashboards, fan\-out joins, malformed models), and tell a genuine platform bug apart from a bad prompt
* Use AI\-assisted / "vibe coding" tools to prototype and validate ideas before spending engineering time


 Be the platform's PM
   

  

* Convert field learnings — recurring friction, capability gaps, real bugs — into prioritized, well\-scoped product work; own the roadmap for one or more areas with the CPO
* Write crisp PRDs and specs engineering and design can build from without guesswork
* Define and track the metrics that matter (time\-to\-value on a deployment, adoption, retention) and report to the CPO
* Partner with engineering, design, sales, and customer success to ship and land features


**Requirements**
**What We're Looking For (must\-haves)**
* Solid SQL — day one, non\-negotiable. You can write and debug non\-trivial queries (joins, aggregations, window functions, CASE logic) without ramp\-up. This is tested in the interview
* Proven data modelling. You can take messy source tables and design a clean, correct model — reasoning about grain, keys, relationships, incremental loading, and dedup. Comfortable with a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery a plus)
* Operate and critically evaluate AI agents / AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, Replit, v0, Lovable) — you build with them and reliably catch when they're wrong
* A correctness mindset — you never confuse "it ran" or "it looks done" with "it's right," especially where data drives decisions
* Strong product instincts: turn ambiguous, real\-world needs into clear requirements and prioritize ruthlessly
* Excellent communication — equally credible with a customer's QC lead, your engineers, and the CPO
* High agency; comfortable owning a customer's outcome in a fast\-moving, ambiguous environment
* 3\-5 years in product management, forward\-deployed / solutions engineering, data/analytics engineering, or a hands\-on technical delivery role
* Bachelor's in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field (or equivalent hands\-on experience)


**Good to Have**
* Experience in pharma / life sciences / manufacturing / quality / compliance (GxP) — not required; we'll teach the domain to someone with the hunger to master it
* Prior forward\-deployed, implementation, or solutions experience deploying software directly at customers
* Ontology / semantic\-layer experience; familiarity with data\-pipeline or warehouse tooling (dbt, Data form, Airflow, or similar)
* A portfolio of things you've actually built (including with AI tools)
* Early\-stage start\-up experience


**Benefits**
* Be part of a fast\-growing SaaS company transforming the future of pharmaceutical manufacturing through cutting\-edge technology
* Collaborate with a passionate, high\-performing team building innovative AI\-powered digital solutions
* Take ownership of impactful client implementations from day one, with ample opportunities for learning, career growth, and professional development

title: Senior Product Manager – Freight Forwarding / 3PL
description:
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager – Freight Forwarding / 3PL to drive the strategy, roadmap, and execution of digital products that enable modern freight forwarding and third\-party logistics operations.
 



 The ideal candidate will bring strong logistics domain expertise, particularly across freight forwarding, transportation, warehousing, shipment management, carrier management, customs, order fulfilment, and supply\-chain operations, combined with a proven track record of building and scaling B2B digital products.
 



 You will work closely with customers, business stakeholders, operations teams, engineering, design, data, and technology teams to identify high\-value problems and translate them into scalable products and solutions.
 



  





**Job Locations** 
 : Bangalore, Chennai, Kochi, Trivandrum
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Product Strategy \& Vision** 



* Define and drive the product vision and strategy for freight forwarding / 3PL products.
* Develop product roadmaps aligned with business objectives, customer needs, and market trends.
* Identify opportunities to digitize and optimize logistics and supply\-chain processes.
* Conduct market, customer, competitor, and industry analysis to identify product opportunities.
* Define product KPIs and establish mechanisms to measure product adoption, customer value, operational efficiency, and business impact.



**Freight Forwarding \& Logistics Products** 




 Own and evolve products across one or more of the following areas:
 


* Shipment / freight management
* Transportation Management Systems (TMS)
* Warehouse Management Systems (WMS)
* Order and fulfilment management
* Carrier / vendor management
* Rate management and freight pricing
* Booking and shipment planning
* Track \& Trace / shipment visibility
* Customs and trade compliance
* Documentation and invoicing
* Last\-mile and delivery management
* Returns management
* Customer portals and self\-service
* Logistics control towers
* Supply\-chain visibility and analytics
* Integration with carriers, ports, airlines, shipping lines, marketplaces, ERP and other enterprise systems



**Product Discovery \& Customer Focus** 



* Engage directly with customers and logistics operations teams to understand pain points and unmet needs.
* Translate complex logistics workflows into intuitive digital experiences.
* Conduct user research, discovery workshops, interviews, and validation exercises.
* Define customer journeys, personas, use cases, and product requirements.
* Prioritize opportunities based on customer value, business impact, feasibility, and strategic alignment.



**Product Execution** 



* Own the product backlog and prioritization across multiple squads / product areas.
* Develop PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional specifications.
* Partner closely with Engineering, UX/UI, Architecture, Data, QA, and Operations teams.
* Drive product development from discovery through launch and post\-launch optimization.
* Resolve product trade\-offs and ensure timely delivery of high\-quality solutions.
* Establish effective Agile product practices and continuously improve product development processes.



**Data, Automation \& AI** 



* Leverage data and analytics to improve logistics decision\-making and operational efficiency.
* Identify opportunities for automation across freight forwarding and 3PL workflows.
* Explore and incorporate AI/ML, GenAI, predictive analytics, intelligent document processing, optimization, and automation into logistics products where relevant.
* Define experiments and measure outcomes to validate product hypotheses.



**Stakeholder \& Business Management** 



* Collaborate with senior business and operations leaders to align product strategy with organizational priorities.
* Work with sales and pre\-sales teams to support enterprise customer engagements where required.
* Communicate product vision, roadmap, priorities, progress, risks, and outcomes to senior leadership.
* Influence cross\-functional teams without direct authority.



**Required Qualifications** 



* 8\+ years of experience in Product Management, with significant experience in logistics, supply chain, transportation, freight forwarding, or 3PL products.
* Strong understanding of freight forwarding and/or 3PL business processes and operating models.
* Experience building and scaling B2B / enterprise SaaS or logistics technology products.
* Proven experience owning products through the complete lifecycle: discovery → strategy → roadmap → development → launch → adoption → optimization.
* Strong understanding of transportation, logistics, and supply\-chain workflows.
* Experience working with enterprise customers and complex stakeholder environments.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, prioritization, and decision\-making skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum product development environments.
* Ability to translate complex business problems into simple, scalable product solutions.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience with TMS, WMS, OMS, freight management, shipment visibility, logistics marketplaces, or supply\-chain platforms.
* Experience across air freight, ocean freight, road transportation, or multimodal logistics.
* Understanding of customs, trade compliance, freight rating, documentation, invoicing, and carrier operations.
* Experience with ERP and enterprise integrations such as SAP or Oracle.
* Experience with APIs, EDI, carrier integrations, and logistics ecosystem integrations.
* Experience building products for global logistics operations.
* Exposure to AI/ML, GenAI, automation, optimization, or data products in logistics.
* Experience managing products across multiple geographies or business units.
* MBA / PGDM from a reputed institution is a plus.
* Engineering / Computer Science / Technology background is a plus.



**Key Competencies** 




 Domain
 


* Freight Forwarding
* 3PL
* Supply Chain \& Logistics
* Transportation
* Warehousing
* Shipment Management



 Product
 


* Product Strategy
* Product Discovery
* Roadmap Management
* Product Prioritization
* Customer Experience
* Product Analytics
* Agile Product Development



 Technology
 


* SaaS / Enterprise Platforms
* APIs \& Integrations
* TMS / WMS / OMS
* Data \& Analytics
* AI / ML / GenAI
* Automation



 Leadership
 


* Strategic Thinking
* Stakeholder Management
* Executive Communication
* Cross\-functional Leadership
* Customer Orientation
* Problem Solving



**Success Measures** 




 Success in this role will be measured through:
 


* Product adoption and customer engagement
* Customer satisfaction and retention
* Revenue / business impact
* Reduction in logistics operating costs
* Process automation and productivity improvement
* Reduction in manual intervention and errors
* Shipment visibility and operational efficiency
* Product delivery predictability and quality
* Successful launch and scaling of new product capabilities



  





 The ideal candidate is a domain\-led Senior Product Manager who understands how freight actually moves through the logistics ecosystem and can translate those operational complexities into scalable technology products.
 



 They should be comfortable discussing topics such as freight rates, carrier booking, shipment lifecycle, documentation, customs, warehouse operations, transportation planning, track \& trace, delivery, invoicing, and logistics integrations, while also being strong in modern product management practices.
 



  





 Candidates coming from freight forwarders, 3PLs, logistics technology companies, supply\-chain SaaS companies, TMS/WMS providers, or enterprise technology organizations serving the logistics industry would be particularly relevant.

title: Associate Product Manager (Flights)
description:
Role: Associate Product Manager
   

  

 Location: Gurugram
   

  

**About The Function**
 When it comes to booking a flight, MakeMyTrip is the undisputed leader in the air travel segment. The other well recognized brand under the Go\-MMT umbrella is Goibibo, a leading online travel booking platform providing a range of travel options for the user.
   

  

 The Flights Product team is the backbone of the Go\-MMT Air business and creates high positive impact by solving end user problems and identifying areas to generate value across pre\-sales and post\-sales. Some of the key metrics which we work on are Funnel Conversion, Monetization, Ancillary uptake, and NPS.
   

  

 Within Flights, the Post Sales charter owns the customer experience after a booking is completed. This includes servicing journeys such as cancellations, date changes, refunds, airline disruptions, web check\-in, flight status, add\-ons, support, and other booking\-management use cases.
   

  

**The Charter Has Two Core Objectives**
 Build simple, reliable and intuitive digital self\-service journeys that allow customers to manage their bookings independently. Identify relevant opportunities to upsell products and services post booking, helping customers enhance and protect their upcoming trip.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Incumber will be responsible for owning customer journeys across the post\-booking lifecycle — from understanding a customer's servicing need to ensuring that the request is successfully fulfilled. This could include journeys such as cancellation, date change, refunds, airline disruption management, web check\-in, flight tracking, baggage, seats, meals, and other post\-booking services.
   

  

 What will you be doing
   

  

 Own end\-to\-end post\-sales customer journeys across key servicing use cases such as cancellation, date change, refunds, disruptions, web check\-in, flight status and booking management. Owning the AI\-powered Voice Bot roadmap for the post\-sales journey — conceptualizing and building accurate, scalable, and impactful conversational experiences that resolve customer needs autonomously. Drive digital adoption of post\-sales journeys by improving discoverability, simplifying flows, reducing friction and building customer trust in self\-service. Track metrics such as digital adoption, self\-service completion rate, customer drop\-offs, contact rate, agent dependency, resolution rate and customer satisfaction to continuously improve servicing journeys. Identify opportunities to reduce customer contacts and agent effort per booking while ensuring that automation does not compromise customer experience or resolution quality. Collaborating closely with technology, design, QA, supply, finance, AI/ML, and customer support teams to ensure seamless execution of product releases. Owning and tracking key product KPIs, Analyzing performance continuously, and iterating post\-launch to strengthen adoption and experience. Owning the AI\-powered Voice Bot roadmap for the post\-sales journey — conceptualizing and building accurate, scalable, and impactful conversational experiences that resolve customer needs autonomously. Defining and driving the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI\-led servicing to deliver measurable improvements in automation, deflection, and customer satisfaction. Building and operationalizing Evals (evaluation frameworks) to measure Voice Bot quality, accuracy, and reliability, and driving consistent quality improvements based on these signals. Defining, measuring, and improving customer frustration scores across bot interactions, and using these insights to refine flows and responses. Measuring actual agent handoff rates and driving initiatives to systematically reduce handoffs through higher\-quality automation and expanded coverage. Continuously identifying and adding new post\-sales use cases for the Voice Bot to handle, expanding automation coverage while maintaining quality. Collaborating closely with technology, design, QA, supply, finance, AI/ML, and customer support teams to ensure seamless execution of product releases. Owning and tracking key product KPIs, Analyzing performance continuously, and iterating post\-launch to strengthen adoption and experience.
   

  

 Qualification \& Experience

 Customer Centricity: A deep passion for understanding and improving customer and partner experiences. Ownership \& Execution: Ability to translate ideas into impactful products through structured execution and cross\-functional collaboration. Strategic Thinking: Aptitude for building long\-term product vision aligned with business goals. Analytical Rigor: Data\-driven approach to problem\-solving and decision\-making, especially around Evals, quality metrics, and handoff reduction. Innovation \& Agility: Eagerness to experiment with AI, learn quickly, and adapt solutions to dynamic market needs. title: Sr. Product Manager - Tech, Just Walk Out Technology
description:
**Description**
 As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon's unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day\-to\-day operations. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon's real\-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no\-brainers to buy and easy to use.
   

  

 Just Walk Out (JWO) enables shopping in retail stores with no lines and no checkout. You simply use a credit card to enter the store, take what you want from our selection of fresh, delicious meals and grocery essentials, and leave the store. This checkout\-free shopping experience is made possible by Just Walk Out Technology, which automatically detects whether products are taken or returned, and enables shoppers to grab and go from stores ranging from small airport kiosks to massive university stores.
   

  

 The Merchant In\-Store Operations team, within JWO, owns the tools, systems, and workflows that enable merchants and their store associates to operate autonomous retail environments at scale. The role spans directly working with two engineering teams that are responsible for unattended store operations, planogram and product layout tooling, and in\-store associate experience and education; Together, these teams serve JWO's growing global footprint, supporting diverse retail configurations—from fully staffed locations to completely unattended kiosks and micro\-markets—enabling merchants across Sports, Education, Travel, Healthcare, and Hospitality verticals to run Just Walk Out stores efficiently and confidently. This Senior Product Manager\-Tech will own the product vision spanning both teams, defining how merchants and store teams interact with, monitor, and maintain their autonomous retail environments day\-to\-day, and how customer support and tech operations teams diagnose and resolve issues at speed.
   

  

 You will define the product roadmap spanning two engineering teams—In\-Store Operations —covering unattended store operations, store associate tooling, planogram management, store availability, and customer support experience capabilities that scale from hundreds to thousands of stores with vastly different operational models. You will work with Enterprise Customers, System Integrators, Engineering, Solution Architects, Customer Support, and Tech Operations teams to drive the long\-term Merchant In\-Store Operations vision as JWO expands from 350\+ stores today to thousands of stores globally. This role requires deep understanding of physical retail operations, store\-level workflows, customer support systems, and the ability to design intuitive tools that empower merchants, frontline associates, and support teams to succeed in autonomous retail environments.
   

  

 As a tenured Product Manager, you are familiar with the product development lifecycle. You exhibit high proficiency and efficacy in core product management disciplines such as defining user stories, priorities, success metrics, presenting vision that works backwards from customers, and are comfortable driving clarity across multiple stakeholders in a fast\-paced and ambiguous environment. A successful candidate will combine an ability to Think Big with keen attention to detail. We are looking for a passionate, data\-driven decision maker who likes building from scratch, experimenting with emerging technologies like generative AI and AI\-powered agents, and setting high standards. You have a high degree of ownership, deep retail operations and customer support expertise, and are an excellent written and verbal communicator who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define and evangelize the long\-term vision for Merchant In\-Store Operations, developing strategic roadmaps for unattended operations, planogram tooling, and in\-store associate experience that align with Just Walk Out's goal of scaling from 400 to 7,000\+ stores by 2028
* Own the unattended operations strategy, designing and delivering the systems, workflows, and merchant\-facing capabilities that enable fully unmanned JWO stores (micro\-markets, kiosks, grab\-and\-go locations) to operate reliably at scale with minimal human intervention, including remote monitoring, automated alerting, and self\-service recovery mechanisms
* Lead the planogram tools vision and execution, owning the end\-to\-end product experience that enables merchants and solution architects to design, configure, validate, and update store layouts and product placements across diverse physical formats, reducing planogram setup time and improving accuracy for new store launches and seasonal resets
* Own the JWO In\-Store Associate Experience and Education strategy, building intuitive tools, dashboards, and training resources that empower store associates to understand autonomous retail operations, troubleshoot common issues, manage day\-to\-day store tasks, and deliver excellent customer service in a checkout\-free environment
* Partner with engineering leadership to deliver scalable, enterprise\-grade in\-store operations capabilities, making technical decisions that balance merchant needs across diverse verticals (Sports, Education, Travel, Healthcare, Hospitality) with engineering constraints, platform stability, and the ability to support stores with vastly different physical layouts and operational requirements
* Own the operational playbook for unattended store formats, defining standard operating procedures, escalation paths, and automated remediation workflows that ensure consistent store uptime and customer experience across geographies and merchant types
* Define and track key metrics including store uptime, mean\-time\-to\-resolution, associate task completion rates, planogram accuracy, and merchant satisfaction to drive continuous improvement and inform product investment decisions
* Build and maintain relationships with enterprise customers and cross\-functional stakeholders, gathering requirements from merchants operating at scale, understanding in\-store operational constraints, and ensuring Merchant In\-Store Operations capabilities meet current needs while anticipating future requirements as the business scales globally

title: Product Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Summit Works Technology (SWTech Labs) is a boutique software engineering firm that builds mission\-critical enterprise systems for organizations that demand high reliability, performance, and long\-term maintainability. The company works primarily through referrals and long\-term relationships, embedding deeply with client teams and taking technical ownership of complex platforms.
 



  





**The job** 




 Turn a set of priorities into specifications an engineer can build from, and keep the numbers that tell everyone whether it worked. Two to Five years of experience is the expectation; curiosity and clear writing matter more than a title history.
 



  





**What you own** 




 •  Specifications the engineer can build from without a meeting — including edge cases, empty states and failure paths, which is where most junior specs fall short.
 



 •  Release coordination and quality checks. Nothing ships without someone using it end to end first, and that someone is you.
 



 •  Match rate and time\-to\-match. You will not own the strategy that moves them, but you own knowing where they stand and why they moved.
 



 •  Taxonomy maintenance — one controlled vocabulary for stage, sector, format and funding type. Providers select from it; they never invent tags.
 



 •  User research. Tens of founder interviews in month one, then a standing cadence. This is the fastest way for you to build judgement, and the fastest way for us to learn.
 



 •  Working with the Data Analyst on the weekly pack, with metric definitions signed off by the GM.
 



 •  This is not the complete list. Opportunity to work on other related/adjacent projects.
 



**What we are looking for** 




 •  Two to five years in product, associate product, business analysis, or a founding role at something small.
 



 •  Writes unusually clearly. Send us a spec, a teardown or a piece of analysis we weight this above your CV.
 



 •  Basic SQL, or the demonstrated ability to learn it inside a month. You will pull your own numbers.
 



 •  Detail\-obsessive about flows. If you have ever filed a bug report nobody asked you to file, mention it.
 



 •  Comfortable being the most junior person in most conversations, and asking the question anyway.
 



 •  Experience working with latest AI tools.
 



  





 Base:
 **Bangalore or Mumbai (Remote and Co\-Working Space)** 




 Reports to: General Manager
 



 Works with: Technology Head and GM
 



 Compensation: ₹10–20 lakh \+ Bonus \+ Perks

* Ownership Expectation: You will own assigned solution and enablement areas from opportunity discovery through working solution, documented handoff, and reusable field learning, in close partnership with the outbound Product Manager.


**What You Will Own**
* Own assigned solution and outbound product activities across opportunity discovery, solution definition, demonstration, validation, delivery enablement, feedback capture, and reusable solution packaging.
* Review the sales pipeline with Sales and Pre\-Sales teams to identify high\-priority solution needs, technical gaps, reusable patterns, and opportunities where product expertise can accelerate progress.
* Translate customer objectives into solution blueprints using workflows, connectors, APIs, transformations, business rules, schedules, event triggers, exception handling, logs, and governance capabilities.
* Build hands\-on demonstrations, workflow prototypes, proof\-of\-concepts, reference implementations, and solution accelerators directly across Bizdata products.
* Lead discovery and solution workshops covering current\-state processes, data flows, systems, constraints, success criteria, risks, and target solution design.
* Prepare workshop agendas, discovery questions, architecture views, solution narratives, demo scripts, implementation guidance, and clear follow\-up actions.
* Support opportunity teams with solution positioning, technical responses, feasibility assessment, effort assumptions, scope boundaries, risk identification, and product capability clarification.
* Bridge platform knowledge across Sales, Pre\-Sales, Consulting, Partners, and delivery teams to ensure proposed solutions are technically credible, appropriately scoped, and aligned with product best practices.
* Create reusable solution templates, playbooks, design patterns, checklists, training content, demo environments, and reference assets to improve reuse and reduce dependence on individual experts.
* Enable partners and internal teams through platform workshops, office hours, solution reviews, and practical build sessions.
* Guide early\-stage implementation teams on configuration standards, error handling, observability, security, performance, supportability, and handover expectations.
* Capture recurring field requests and lost\-deal gaps, distinguish configuration needs from product enhancements, and provide evidence\-based inputs to the product roadmap.
* Track solution outcomes, including workshop effectiveness, prototype completion, opportunity progression, delivery acceleration, reuse, and post\-engagement feedback.
* Maintain clear ownership and follow\-through until every solution has an agreed path, responsible team, next action, and documented handoff.


**How You Will Collaborate**
* Work with Sales and Pre\-Sales to qualify solution needs, prepare demonstrations, and strengthen technical confidence in active opportunities.
* Partner with Consulting and implementation teams to convert solution intent into practical delivery guidance and reduce avoidable discovery and design rework.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering to validate feasibility, communicate field insights, and improve platform capabilities and documentation.
* Support Partners and Customer Success teams with training, reusable assets, solution reviews, and escalation paths.
* Communicate solution decisions, assumptions, exclusions, dependencies, risks, and next steps clearly to technical and business stakeholders.


**Required Qualifications**
* BE/BTech and MBA are mandatory.
* 14 years of relevant experience in Product Management, Business Analysis, Pre\-Sales, Solution Consulting, Implementation, Customer Success, Enterprise Software, or a related technology role.
* Freshers are not eligible for this role.
* Strong interest in hands\-on solution development using integration, automation, low\-code/no\-code, API, database, ERP, eCommerce, or SaaS platforms.
* Ability to understand business processes, ask structured discovery questions, map system and data flows, and convert requirements into practical solution approaches.
* Confidence in presenting to customers, partners, sales teams, consultants, and technical stakeholders through workshops, demonstrations, and solution reviews.
* Strong written communication and documentation skills for solution briefs, workshop outputs, demos, playbooks, and handoffs.
* Readiness to take end\-to\-end ownership, learn the platform deeply, build solutions personally, and remain accountable for field outcomes.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Product Management certification is an added advantage.
* Exposure to iPaaS, APIs, webhooks, databases, ERP applications, eCommerce platforms, cloud services, integration patterns, or workflow automation.
* Experience in solution consulting, pre\-sales engineering, partner enablement, customer workshops, proof\-of\-concepts, or implementation delivery.
* Ability to interpret API documentation, JSON/XML payloads, mappings, logs, errors, authentication methods, and integration architecture diagrams.
* Experience creating reusable demos, accelerators, templates, technical training, or implementation best\-practice content.


**Capabilities That Will Make You Successful**
* Solution Thinking: Connect business outcomes, process design, platform capabilities, and delivery practicality.
* Platform Depth: Build credibility by learning the product hands\-on and validating recommendations through working configurations.
* Commercial Awareness: Understand opportunity urgency, stakeholder expectations, scope risks, and what is required to move decisions forward.
* Facilitation: Run structured workshops that produce decisions, requirements, solution direction, and clear next steps.
* Enablement Mindset: Convert individual engagements into reusable knowledge and assets that help teams deliver faster.
* Ownership \& Follow\-Through: Close gaps across functions and ensure important actions have clear ownership.


**Success Measures**
* Faster movement of qualified opportunities from discovery to validated solutions or proof\-of\-concepts.
* Higher quality and consistency of proposed solutions, with fewer platform knowledge gaps and avoidable scope issues.
* Reduced time for Consulting, Partners, and customer teams to design and deliver repeatable Bizdata solutions.
* Growth in reusable solution assets, workshop playbooks, demonstrations, and reference implementations adopted by field teams.
* Improved customer and partner confidence, workshop outcomes, delivery handoffs, and field\-to\-product feedback quality.


**Why This Role Matters**
* This role directly influences how quickly Bizdata converts customer, partner, and market needs into credible solutions, measurable outcomes, and reusable product capabilities.
* You will be expected to learn the platform deeply, work across functions, build solutions hands\-on, and demonstrate ownership from opportunity discovery through solution validation, delivery enablement, and continuous field learning.


**Equal Opportunity**
 Bizdata is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse perspectives and evaluate applicants based on role\-relevant skills, experience, potential, and alignment with our working principles.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**About Angel One:** 




  





 Angel One is one of India’s fastest\-growing fintechs, on a bold mission to make investing simple, smart, and inclusive for every Indian. With over 3\+ crore clients, we’re building at scale – and building for impact.
 



  





 Our Super App helps clients manage their investments, trade seamlessly, and access financial tools tailored to their goals. We are working to build personalized financial journeys for our clients, powered by new\-age tech, AI, Machine Learning and Data Science.
 



  





 We're a builder company at heart. You’ll have the space to experiment, the freedom to move with velocity, and the mandate to make bold, user\-first decisions – every single day.
 



 The vibe? Think less hierarchy, more momentum. Everyone has a seat at the table and a shot to build something that lasts.
 



  





 Be part of a team that’s scaling sustainably, thinking big, and building for the next billion.
 



  





**Why You'll Love Working at Angel One!** 




  




* **Tech Systems that run at Scale:** 
 From AI to real\-time data infra, you’ll work on tech that’s ahead of the curve and solve problems that truly matter.
* **Build one of India’s Leading Fintech Platform:** 
 We’re not just disrupting finance – we’re shaping how billion Indians access wealth.
* **Own It. Drive It. Scale It:** 
 You’ll have the freedom to lead, the resources to build, and the opportunity to leave your mark.
* **Empowered Growth:** 
 We invest in your growth and empower you to explore your full potential.
* **Exceptional Benefits:** 
 Our comprehensive benefits package includes health insurance, wellness programs, learning \& development opportunities, and more.



  





**Job Title:** 
 Senior Product Manager (lending /B2C)
 



**Location:** 
 Bangalore
 



  





**What you will do** 




  





 As Senior Product Manager, you will own and drive the lending product experience at Angel One from credit discovery and application through to disbursal and loan lifecycle management. You will set the vision for your product area, influence cross\-functional teams, and lead execution of initiatives that grow our lending book sustainably while delivering seamless, trustworthy experiences for millions of customers.
 


* Own the product roadmap for your area end\-to\-end define priorities, manage trade\-offs, and align engineering, design, data, and business stakeholders around a shared direction
* Define and track the right success metrics; continuously identify opportunities to improve conversion, engagement, and business outcomes
* Lead discovery and validation — through user research, data analysis, and market signals to identify and size high\-impact opportunities before committing to build
* Write sharp, detailed product specs and drive cross\-functional execution from concept through launch, with clear accountability at every stage
* Work closely with external partners / lenders, NBFCs, fintechs, and technology service providers to design and ship integrations that expand product capabilities and customer reach
* Collaborate with design to raise the bar on user experience across complex, multi\-step financial journeys
* Partner with data and analytics to build instrumentation, run experiments, and drive a data\-first product culture
* Navigate regulatory, compliance, and risk considerations as a core part of product decision\-making not an afterthought
* Represent the voice of the customer internally synthesising qualitative and quantitative signals into decisions the whole organisation can act on
* Share learnings, results, and product thinking broadly contributing to a culture of transparency and continuous improvement



  





  





**What you are**




  




* 8\+ years of overall work experience with 5\+ years in product management
* Demonstrated track record of owning and scaling B2C digital products at significant scale
* Experience building financial services, lending, or credit products; familiarity with loan journeys, lender integrations, or credit underwriting flows is a strong plus
* Comfortable working with APIs and technically complex partner integrations
* Strong data orientation at ease with product analytics, A/B experimentation, and translating data into decisions
* Sharp user research instincts experienced with usability testing, user interviews, and turning insight into action
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills and can align diverse teams and influence without authority
* Experience working with external partners such as banks, NBFCs, or fintechs is an advantage
* Engineering or management degree from a Tier 1 institution preferred



  





**What's in it for You?** 




  




* **Empowered Growth:** 
 🚀 We invest in your growth and empower you to explore your full potential.
* **Hybrid work model** 
 🏖️: Enjoy in\-person collaboration a few days a week, striking the perfect balance between productivity and personal preferences.
* **Exceptional Benefits:** 
 🧘 ♀️ Our comprehensive benefits package includes health insurance, wellness programs, learning \& development opportunities, and more.



  





**At Angel One, our thriving culture is rooted in Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI).** 




*As an Equal opportunity employer, we wholeheartedly welcome people from all backgrounds irrespective of caste, religion, gender, marital status, sexuality, disability, class or age to be part of our team.We believe that everyone's unique experiences and viewpoints make us stronger together.Come and be a part of \#OneSpace\*, where your individuality is celebrated and embraced.*
